properties.description: Answers a field report by fixing its class rather than its instances. add_epoch and plan_epoch take a description and a checksum, add_requirement takes a priority, and add_interface, add_project, add_release, add_resource, add_environment and add_artifact each take a description — six constructors that could not say what the thing they made IS. record_finding makes the moment a cause is written into a tool call, and its description demands the root-cause skill by name, which is the first use of a tool-side demand to reach a skill whose trigger is the agent's own state. The reachability instrument stops fusing reachability with adoption, asks per type rather than across a flat name pool, and runs in CI as a regression gate over a grandfathered baseline. Also carries the design record: five rulings, the triage of all 46 overtaken defect records, and today's field-feedback triage.
properties.name: v0.52.0 — the vocabulary the surface could not write
